name: R107-baton-pass-onto-ai-spikes
why: Challenge 4. The opponent's Skarmory (482: Spikes, Roar, Drill Peck, Toxic) lays Spikes on the player's side. The player's Mr. Mime (478, Baton Pass) and its two bulky partners play random legal actions; when a wounded partner is the Baton Pass choice it faints on the Spikes and the player must choose again with a Pokemon left (resumeFullTurnForcedSwitch). Random play, so most seeds miss.
